name: log
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT ts, CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE) AS sample
  FROM {{traces}}
  WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND (service = $service)
    AND "duration_us" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE)) AND duration_us >= 0
), positioned AS (
  SELECT ts, sample, sign(sample) * log10(1 + abs(sample)) AS position FROM filtered
), bounds AS (
  SELECT floor(min(position)) AS lo, CASE WHEN ceil(max(position)) > floor(min(position)) THEN ceil(max(position))
    ELSE floor(min(position)) + greatest(abs(floor(min(position))) * 0.01, 1) END AS hi, max(sample) AS sample_max FROM positioned
), settings AS (
  SELECT INTERVAL '1 second' * greatest(1, ceil(epoch(CAST($end AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST($start AS TIMESTAMP)) / $cf1)) AS step
), bucketed AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(step, ts) AS ts_bucket,
    least($cf0 - 1, greatest(0, CAST(floor((position - lo) / (hi - lo) * $cf0) AS INTEGER))) AS y_bucket,
    lo, hi, sample_max, epoch(step) * 1000 AS __bucket_ms
  FROM positioned CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN settings
)
SELECT ts_bucket, y_bucket, sign((lo + (hi - lo) * y_bucket / $cf0)) * (pow(10, abs((lo + (hi - lo) * y_bucket / $cf0))) - 1) AS bucket_min,
  sign((lo + (hi - lo) * (y_bucket + 1) / $cf0)) * (pow(10, abs((lo + (hi - lo) * (y_bucket + 1) / $cf0))) - 1) AS bucket_max,
  count(*) AS value, __bucket_ms, lo AS __scale_min, hi AS __scale_max, sample_max AS __sample_max
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY ts_bucket, y_bucket, lo, hi, sample_max, __bucket_ms
ORDER BY ts_bucket, y_bucket
LIMIT 10001

name: linear
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT ts, CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE) AS sample
  FROM {{traces}}
  WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND (service = $service)
    AND "duration_us" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST("duration_us" AS DOUBLE)) AND duration_us >= 0
), positioned AS (
  SELECT ts, sample, sample AS position FROM filtered
), bounds AS (
  SELECT min(position) AS lo, CASE WHEN max(position) > min(position) THEN max(position)
    ELSE min(position) + greatest(abs(min(position)) * 0.01, 1) END AS hi, max(sample) AS sample_max FROM positioned
), settings AS (
  SELECT greatest(CAST($chart_bucket AS INTERVAL), INTERVAL '1 second' * greatest(1, ceil(epoch(CAST($end AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST($start AS TIMESTAMP)) / $cf1))) AS step
), bucketed AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(step, ts) AS ts_bucket,
    least($cf0 - 1, greatest(0, CAST(floor((position - lo) / (hi - lo) * $cf0) AS INTEGER))) AS y_bucket,
    lo, hi, sample_max, epoch(step) * 1000 AS __bucket_ms
  FROM positioned CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN settings
)
SELECT ts_bucket, y_bucket, (lo + (hi - lo) * y_bucket / $cf0) AS bucket_min,
  (lo + (hi - lo) * (y_bucket + 1) / $cf0) AS bucket_max,
  count(*) AS value, __bucket_ms, lo AS __scale_min, hi AS __scale_max, sample_max AS __sample_max
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY ts_bucket, y_bucket, lo, hi, sample_max, __bucket_ms
ORDER BY ts_bucket, y_bucket
LIMIT 10001
